rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Champagne Celebration
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, 2009).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2009 as 'Champagne Celebration'.
rows.Bloom: Cream. Champagne. Moderate fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
